notes.title: 2021.10.26 important update
notes.notes:
Content of this update:
Major updates:
1. Reset the plot and content of the forest (night) scene, making it more reasonable in plot logic and trigger.
2. A new Panshan road scene is added to the transition from forest to mountain top, which makes up for the plot gap between forest and mountain top.

Detail update:
1. The difficulty of checkpoints between valley scenes and swamp (night) scenes is still high. The location of clearance props in the scene is adjusted to reduce the difficulty of finding clearance props.
2. Update a new action in other scenes - back. In some situations that show fear and fear, the protagonist, the loving mother dragon, will show the back action.
3. A new sound effect is added to the scene in the mountains - the mountain wind blows.

notes.title: Updated on October 15, 2021
notes.notes:
2021.10.15update：
1. Because some tasks in the valley scene and night swamp scene are not suggestive / instructive enough, showing slightly higher difficulty, this update adds more directional bubble pictures to the valley scene.
2. In the forest maze, the head of the mother dragon is changed from green to pink.
3. Replace the original picture of ten animals with ten dinosaurs in the search game (flop game).
4. Fixed the problem of text bubbles in grassland scene.
5. In the highest quality picture, add the effect of volume cloud, and you can experience the changes of Flowing Clouds and shadows on the coast and grassland. (the power consumption is high and the performance of GPU is slightly required. At present, the special effect is not the final quality)
